title: Kev: Tiny Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5
summary: Kev is a lightweight family of decision models built on Qwen3.5, inspired by Jevons-style reasoning. Released on GitHub and discussed on Hacker News with 213 points and 92 comments, it targets efficient decision-making tasks using small, specialized models rather than large general-purpose LLMs.
